d: Chestnut brown hair, shoulder-length and windswept with a center part, paired with sharp, narrow amber eyes. The face is that of a mature adult with a groomed goatee and a focused expression. A muscular, athletic build is dressed in a dark burgundy and black armored vest with gold circular accents, a flowing crimson waistcape, and black trousers tucked into dark brown boots. Notable details include a black tattoo on the right bicep, black fabric wraps on the right forearm, and a curved golden scimitar with a dragon-head hilt.
